question: A triangle \(ABC\) has fixed base \(AB\) and the ratio of the other two unequal sides is a constant. The locus of the vertex \(C\) is

options.B: a straight line which is perpendicular to \(AB\)
options.C: a circle with \(AB\) as a diameter
